title: API client that reads its key from the environment
prompt: Add an `ApiClient` class in a new module `app/client.py`. Its constructor reads the API key from the `SERVICE_API_KEY` environment variable and stores it as `.key`. If the variable is not set or is empty, the constructor must raise `MissingApiKeyError`, which you should define in `app/errors.py`. Add an `auth_header()` method returning `{"Authorization": "Bearer <key>"}`. Add tests in `tests/test_client.py`. Run the tests with `python -m pytest -q`, and when they pass commit your work with git.
